description: Expected stage-6 (cut_planner) output when the matcher is given script_v1_literal.txt against the three takes in canonical.json. Script v1 is a literal/close paraphrase: beat 1 matches take 0 almost word-for-word ('Hello and welcome back'), beat 2 matches take 1 almost word-for-word ('Today I want to talk about something interesting'). The planner does NOT prefer the higher-quality take 2 for beat 2 because beat 2's literal text contains 'interesting' which only take 1 says — semantic match dominates over raw quality when scores are close.

cuts.beat_text: Hello and welcome back to my channel.
cuts.snap_notes: Cut start snapped to first VAD speech boundary at 2.083s (frame-quantized from 2.10). End snapped to nearest VAD silence boundary at 4.50s (frame-quantized from 4.45 word_end).

cuts.beat_text: Today I want to talk about something interesting.
cuts.snap_notes: End boundary falls between the word 'interesting' (end 13.90) and the filler 'uh' (start 14.10). Snapped to 14.00 silence midpoint. Word-boundary fade (25 ms) used because the snap landed inside a 0.20 s gap, shorter than the silence_fade threshold for inaudibility.
